source_text: Deduxisti iustitia tua populum tuum hunc quem redemisti. Non meritis nostris sed iustitia Dei. Redemptio praecedit ductum; gratia viam aperit.
pass_a_gloss: You-led with-justice your people your this which you-redeemed. Not by-merits our but justice of-God. Redemption precedes leading; grace way opens.
pass_b_english: [[In your justice you led this people whom you redeemed >> Bible:Exodus 15:13]]. Not our merits but God’s justice. Redemption comes first; grace opens the road.
